# simply_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists DNS records in a Simply.com product DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simply_dns_records" "example" {
  product = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Record comment.
- `data` (String) DNS record data.
- `id` (String) Record ID in the form `product:record_id`.
- `name` (String) Record name within the DNS zone.
- `priority` (Number) Priority value.
- `product` (String) Simply.com product object.
- `record_id` (Number) Simply.com DNS record ID.
- `ttl` (Number) Record TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
